diagnosed_root_causes.hypothesis: Unclear role information may weaken candidate attraction
Manual workflows may limit reporting coverage and consume staff time
Expectation drift may contribute to early exits
A management practice may contribute to exits
Unclear role or progression expectations may contribute to early exits
A delayed hire process may contribute to agency dependence

phase_1_actions.action: Interview target candidates and review conversion for the same jobs and inbound channels.
Audit duplicate handling, reporting effort, source coverage, and ownership.
Compare dated promises, observed work practices and reasons for exits over a comparable hire window.
Compare exits and reported decision rights or manager practices across comparable teams and tenure.
Review onboarding responsibilities, leveling criteria and exit reasons by role and cohort.
Reconcile agency invoices and filled requisitions, then identify the funnel stage delaying the same roles.

strengths: Base compensation and equity packages are benchmarked at the 82nd percentile for European FinTech (0% offer rejections due to base pay), and the Amsterdam Core Platform / SRE division (320 engineers) maintains 94% annual retention with high technical pride.
cohort: 16% of newly hired Senior Software Engineers and PMs in the Milan and Berlin product squads leave within their first 6 months. Newly promoted engineering leads in those two hubs were elevated from individual contributor roles during rapid scale-up without management coaching or a standardized career progression framework.
